title: docs: Console auth feasibility evaluation with @objectstack/client + better-auth
body:
Evaluate whether `@objectstack/client` + `better-auth` can deliver a complete ObjectStack Console from login to full usage. Scanned all 35 packages and the existing console app to produce a gap analysis and implementation plan.

### CONSOLE_AUTH_PLAN.md (new)

- **Capability scan**: 17 production-ready capabilities (CRUD, forms, grids, dashboards, permissions, tenancy, i18n, workflow, AI) — all business UI is done
- **Gap analysis**: 11 missing auth capabilities (login page, session management, route guards, token injection, system object UIs)
- **@objectstack/client**: ✅ Fully sufficient — `token` param + custom `fetch` wrapper enables dynamic Bearer injection from any auth provider
- **better-auth**: ✅ Strong fit — TypeScript-first, React hooks, organization/RBAC plugins map directly to existing `@object-ui/tenant` and `@object-ui/permissions`
- **Architecture**: New `@object-ui/auth` package wrapping better-auth, with `AuthProvider` → `useAuth` → `AuthGuard` API
- **Estimated effort**: ~29 workdays across 3 phases (auth foundation → console integration → system admin)

Key integration pattern:

```typescript
const adapter = new ObjectStackAdapter({
  baseUrl: '/api/v1',
  fetch: async (input, init) => {
    const session = await authClient.getSession();
    const headers = new Headers(init?.headers);
    if (session?.token) headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${session.token}`);
    return fetch(input, { ...init, headers });
  },
});
```

### ROADMAP.md (updated)

- Added **Authentication & Console Gaps (P0)** to current status
- Added **Q1 §1.5 Console Authentication System** — 6-week, 3-phase plan with 15 tasks
- Updated **Q2 §2.3 System Objects** to reference Q1 auth groundwork
- Added plan doc to reference documents
